en: Fixed Claude Code refusing to start when the OS denies reading the managed settings file; it now warns and starts without that file's policies. Other read errors and unparseable files stop every session
zh: 修复操作系统拒绝读取托管设置文件时 Claude Code 拒绝启动的问题；现在会发出警告并在缺少该文件策略的情况下启动。其他读取错误和无法解析的文件仍会终止所有 session
